scientific_integrity: Original formulas for individual best responses and complete multipartite spectral inertia are attributed to earlier work. The proposed additional result is the exact Nash classification and arithmetic balancing condition. Finite checks are not substitutes for proof; historical priority and independent mathematical validation remain unconfirmed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to loopless unweighted complete multipartite networks with common positive alpha, beta, lambda parameters, common prejudice and binary actions; no claims for arbitrary weights, heterogeneity or transient convergence.
title: Exact Nash equilibrium classification for complete multipartite public-goods opinion games
